chunks.content: Comparative claims must reference the specific competitor product and the date of comparison. The base spacing unit is 8 pixels. All margins and padding are multiples of it.
Photograph products in context — on a desk, in a hand, beside the objects people actually use them with. Never photograph on pure white cyclorama. Never use studio strobes that flatten shadows.
Never use the word premium without stating what makes it so. Sustainability claims require a measurable figure and a source. "Eco-friendly" alone is not acceptable.
Never set body copy below 14 pixels or in all capitals. The voice is direct and unhurried. State the benefit and stop.
Avoid stock-photo gestures: pointing at laptops, laughing at salads, handshakes over conference tables. People may appear in photographs, but they are never the subject. The work is the subject.
Do not blur backgrounds artificially. If depth is needed, capture it in the photograph. Headings are set in Bitter. Body copy is set in Source Sans 3. No third typeface.

json.llm_prompt:
You are a creative director preparing a brief for an image generator.

USER REQUEST: product launch banner for a new insulated water bottle
PLATFORM: instagram_square
AUDIENCE: Small business owners
STYLE: editorial photography
Palette (MANDATORY, use only these): primary #2F5D50, secondary #D9C7A3, accent #C4622D
BRAND TONE: clear, practical, warm, unhurried
BRAND TYPEFACE: Bitter

Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences, with these keys:
  "intent"        one short phrase describing what this asset is for
  "subject"       what should physically appear in the frame
  "composition"   layout and framing guidance
  "palette"       array of hex colours to use
  "mood"          two or three adjectives
  "avoid"         array of things the image must not contain
  "image_prompt"  a single detailed sentence for the image model
  "negative_prompt" comma-separated terms to exclude

Do not put readable text or lettering in the image; typography is added later.
